answer_1.quote: We propose converting long videos from the multimodal domain to "small" coherent textual stories by verbalizing keyframes, audio, and text-overlaid scenes with the help of a powerful LLM and instructions
datasets: Image and Video Advertisements (Hussain et al., 2017)

answer_2.quote: Following Li et al. (2020), we use several NLP metrics, viz., BLEU-N, ROUGE-L, METEOR and CIDEr to measure the similarity between the story generated by the model and ground truth

answer_4.quote: Each human annotator watches 15 videos such that each video gets viewed by at least two annotators and answers these questions for each video
answer_4.guideline: We make a list of 15 yes/no type-questions containing questions like "Was there any expert (person or company) (not celebrity) encouraging to use the product/brand? Was the company showcasing any awards (e.g., industrial or government)? Did the video show any customer reviews or testimonials?"
